dedupe_keys.name: ricch database climate change impacts on usable capacity of 542 hydropower plants in the global south

description: The RICCH database (Risk and Impacts of Climate Change on Hydropower) holds design and location characteristics of 542 hydropower plants in 52 countries of the Global South, together with simulated future usable capacity for each plant. It was published on Zenodo in January 2022 by Ana Lucía Cáceres, Paulina Jaramillo, H. Scott Matthews, Constantine Samaras and Bart Nijssen as the data behind the RICCH interactive analysis tool. Usable capacity was simulated with a multi-model ensemble of 21 global climate models from NASA NEX-GDDP under RCP 4.5 and RCP 8.5, and the mean monthly usable capacity in MW is given per plant, model and scenario for 2010-2039, 2040-2069 and 2070-2099; for example Itaipu has a January value for the early century under each model and pathway. Coverage is 542 plants in the Global South. The data are one CSV file of about 135 MB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: results are model projections, and the interactive tool itself is not linked from the record. Simulation uses are stress-testing hydropower supply under drought and changed runoff and screening climate risk for plants and power systems. Related records: data-glohydrores-global-hydropower-reservoirs gives a global plant and reservoir inventory.
